## About
ATI is family owned and operated, and we make our parts in-house. Crankshaft dampers, transmissions and torque converters are engineered and manufactured from start to finish in our facility in Baltimore, Maryland.
Our products run everywhere from your local drag strip and dirt tracks to the high banks of Daytona and the straights of Le Mans. Top engine builders, high performance aftermarket shops and even manufacturers like Ford and GM use them.
Need help matching a converter or transmission to your combination? Our tech staff answers questions before, during and after the sale. Customers rate us 4.6 from 105 Google reviews.

## Services
- Super Damper: Super Damper harmonic balancers for racing and high performance engines, including Serpentine Series, Diesel Dampers and Supercharger Series Dampers.
- Drag Racing Transmissions: Automatic transmissions built for drag racing and high performance use, including the Powerglide, plus the parts that go in them.
- Torque Converters: Treemaster, Outlaw, Bolt Together, Fuel & Blown and Streetmaster Converters, built for the way you race or drive.
- SuperCase: SFI approved transmission cases, including the Powerglide SuperCase.
- SFI Flexplate Kits: SFI flexplate kits for GM LS, LT and Vortec engines.
- Converter stall change or damper overhaul: Send your converter or damper to us with the proper form and we will handle the stall change or overhaul.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Thursday, 8:00 am - 5:00 pm EST. Friday hours run a little shorter, and we're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I get a converter recommendation?
A: Send us your specs on our converter spec form and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Q: Can I send my converter or damper in for service?
A: Yes. For a converter stall change or damper overhaul, send it to us along with the proper form.

Q: How do I register my warranty?
A: Whether you bought direct from us or from one of our vendors, you can complete your warranty registration online.

Q: Where can I find installation instructions?
A: Instructions for installing a damper or transmission are available to download as PDFs.
